sources.title: Transparent G.3 unit, norm, mask, and signal derivations
sources.details: For f=440 cycles/s and Δt=1s, fΔt=440 cycles exactly. For r=||v||₂>0, ||v/r||₂=1; with eps>0 the length is r/max(r,eps), hence zero/tiny vectors can be below1. Fixed nonzero reference energy E_s and positive error E_e give SNR=10log10(E_s/E_e), strictly increasing as E_e falls; silence and zero error are boundary cases. The HTK inverse f(m)=700(10^(m/2595)−1) has increasing Hz steps at equal mel intervals. Shift of T+1 IDs yields two T-length sequences; attention permission and loss inclusion are independent functions. A time label never removes computational input dependencies. Full step-by-step scope is in a_derivations.
